text:
The immediate-successor constraints lock two blocks. Gus is immediately after Hana, and Finn is exactly two slots after Hana, so those three occupy consecutive slots in the order Hana–Gus–Finn. Ben is immediately after Cara, and that pair must sit entirely before Hana; Ben is also at least three slots from Gus, so Ben is at least two slots before Hana. Ivo is before Gus and at least three slots from Hana, so Ivo is at least three slots before Hana.

The only start position for Hana–Gus–Finn that still leaves legal slots for the others is 7–8–9. The remaining constraints then force the rest:

- Cara–Ben must be slots 4–5 (the only pair early enough for Ben’s gaps to Ivo and Gus).
- Ivo must be slot 2 (the only slot at least three before Ben and at least three before Hana).
- Dev must be slot 3 (before Ben, and exactly one slot from Ann).
- Ann must be slot 1 (before Ben, at least three slots from Ben, exactly one slot from Dev).

The only unused name is Eve, in the only open slot.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Ivo","3":"Dev","4":"Cara","5":"Ben","6":"Eve","7":"Hana","8":"Gus","9":"Finn"}
CONFIDENCE: 96
